purpose: Cost and quality baseline: what ASCOS v1.2.2 costs per size bucket, and whether the spend is worth it. Buckets are declared here rather than inherited from each case's group so a case can sit in a different bucket than its corpus group without editing the case.

workspace.note: Every run gets its own copy: a fixture already modified by an earlier run is no longer the same question. E13 is the exception and runs in an empty directory.

excluded.reason: WeChat Pay connector on this host hijacks the request before the skill sees it — an environment contaminant, the same shape as T05 in stage 1, which was recorded invalid and kept out of every denominator.
